stem:
设 \(\left\{a_{n}\right\}\) 是等差数列， \(\left\{b_{n}\right\}\) 是等比数列．已知 \(a_1 = 4, b_1 = 6, b_2 = 2a_2 - 2, b_3 = 2a_3 + 4.\)

（I）求 \(\left\{a_{n}\right\}\) 和 \(\left\{b_{n}\right\}\) 的通项公式；

(Ⅱ) 设数列 \(\left\{c_{n}\right\}\) 满足 \(c_{1}=1, c_{n}=\left\{\begin{aligned}1, & 2^{k}<n<2^{k+1},\\ b_{k}, & n=2^{k},\end{aligned}\right.\) 其中 \(k\in N^{*}\) .

(i) 求数列 \(\left\{a_{2^{n}}\left(c_{2^{n}}-1\right)\right\}\) 的通项公式;

(ii) 求 \(\sum_{i=1}^{2^{n}}a_{i}c_{i}\quad(n\in\mathbf{N}^{*})\) .
